comment: Content-snapshot baseline for the pinned security-surface files. page-shell-contract.test.mjs recomputes each file's SHA-256 (after CRLF->LF normalization for cross-platform/core.autocrlf determinism) and asserts equality with these values. Re-baseline SOP (when/how to refresh): WHEN - only when a change to a pinned security-surface file is intentional and reviewed (e.g. adding a capability permission plus its command, or regenerating bindings.ts after a public DTO change); never to silently absorb unexplained drift. HOW - (1) make the intended change; (2) run the full gate so cargo test regenerates src/generated/bindings.ts; (3) recompute each pinned file's CRLF->LF-normalized SHA-256; (4) update ONLY the changed entries below and verify every file you did not intend to touch keeps its prior hash (a changed hash there means real drift - stop and investigate); (5) confirm page-shell-contract's 'security surface has zero drift' test passes; (6) commit the fixture in the SAME commit as the code change so the accepted drift stays auditable.
